transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora, yes, I do have a few questions. First, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month, so keep it gentle to begin with.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's good to know. Next, I was wondering when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a great question. It's safe to continue using any eye drops or gels you were using before your operation for dry eyes, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're unsure about anything specific with your gel, I'd recommend checking with your GP or pharmacist to confirm it's okay to use.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That makes sense, thank you. Another thing I wanted to ask is that I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Yes, that's quite normal! It's common for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check that further.

Do you have any other questions?

It's quite common to have some blurriness in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

However, I don't have your specific timeline - how long ago was your surgery? If your vision is still quite blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Take care, and best wishes with your recovery.
